title: Games to Explore After Marvel Rivals
description: Compare selected games for Marvel Rivals readers, with clear reasons to explore each setting and links to independent guides.
intro: Marvel Rivals makes hero combinations and team roles important. Explore different match structures through an ability-led battle royale, tactical squad combat, and extraction shooting.
disclosure: These independent guide websites are maintained by the same operator. Recommendations are editorial suggestions, not official partnerships or endorsements. Official game sources are listed separately.

entries.name: Fate Trigger
entries.reason: Research an ability-driven battle royale and its character roles. It offers a way to compare team decisions across a different match structure.
entries.difference: Fate Trigger centres on ability-driven shooting in a battle-royale setting; Marvel Rivals centres on team-based hero combat and role combinations. Similar interests do not imply identical mechanics or multiplayer support.

entries.name: WARDOGS
entries.reason: Explore tactical squad roles and coordinated shooting. Its guide helps you compare team organisation rather than assuming hero abilities or extraction rules carry across games.
entries.difference: WARDOGS centres on tactical shooting and coordinated squad play; Marvel Rivals centres on team-based hero combat and role combinations. Similar interests do not imply identical mechanics or multiplayer support.

entries.name: Beautiful Light
entries.reason: Research a shooter where extraction objectives meet horror imagery. Consider it for armed team encounters and tension rather than for a peaceful exploration loop.
entries.difference: Beautiful Light centres on tactical extraction shooting with horror elements; Marvel Rivals centres on team-based hero combat and role combinations. Similar interests do not imply identical mechanics or multiplayer support.
